title: Father and Child on Bonneville Salt Flats, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Bonneville Salt Flats, Tooele County, Utah, United States
description: A wide-angle black-and-white snapshot capturing a father crouching beside his small child standing on the vast, stark expanse of salt flats, likely the iconic Bonneville Salt Flats in northwestern Utah. In the far background, a rugged mountain range sits under an open sky, crossed along the horizon by distant telephone or power poles. The image evokes the classic mid-20th-century American family road trip across the western desert.
